Summer Fruit Salsa
By: Peas of Cake
Published: Thursday, August 28, 2014 - 1:47pm

Ingredients




Strawberries, diced
Avocado, diced
Mango, diced
Red onion, diced
Jalapeño, finely diced ( I probably used half or less of 1, but base it on your preference!)
Cilantro, roughly chopped
Lime, juiced
Salt and pepper, to taste

Preparation

1 Add all fruit and veggie ingredients in a bowl, adding the avocado last as it can get mushy fast. Gently toss it around. 2 Squeeze in some lime juice and salt and pepper to taste.

About

A fresh and juicy salsa made up of strawberries, mangos, red onion, jalapeno, cilantro and avocado.
Ingredient amounts vary depending on how much you want to make.  I typically just throw whatever amounts I have/prefer in the bowl and it always turns out great!
